note: CON-181 validation set. Community classifications that can falsify CON-180. Every commander name verified against Scryfall card-names. Oracle text fetched from Scryfall /cards/collection and stored inline for offline checks. Disagreement is data — multi-label rows are not collapsed.
source_rule: A row without a source is opinion. Disagreement is recorded, not resolved.

commanders.source: Commander Challenge YJ8X8bO8jeY (expert sac→counters→leave on camera); EDHREC /commanders/hei-bai-spirit-of-balance tag_counts: +1/+1 Counters 49, Aristocrats 19, Tokens 19, Blink 10, Voltron 6
commanders.why: Sac outlet + counters on enter/attack; leaves moves counters (blink payoff); grows tall for voltron

Whenever Hei Bai enters or attacks, you may sacrifice another creature or artifact. If you do, put two +1/+1 counters on Hei Bai.
